NEW_EXACT_FINDING: THROUGH-ONE-STATE CYCLE FAMILY. Take the chain 1->...->7 with holdings lambda_i, and back edges whose cycles all contain state 4 (15 segments [j..k], j<=4<=k, j<k). Since no two cycles are disjoint, the characteristic polynomial is LINEAR in the cycle weights: prod(y+lambda_i) - sum_c w_c B_c, with B_c = prod over i not in c of (y+lambda_i). So, for fixed holdings and (p,q), PH7 spectrum feasibility is the cone membership R := prod(y+lambda_i) - D_z Q in cone{B_c}. The numerator (I={1,2,3}, exit 7) is proportional to Q iff p >= lambda_1+lambda_2 and Q(-lambda_1) >= 0. The actual band (u29/20) is the special case using 4 of the 15 cycles.

With band-type holdings (u,u,u,w,1,1,1) the generators become exactly (y+u)^alpha (y+1)^beta, 0<=alpha,beta<=3, (alpha,beta)!=(3,3). With x=y+1, delta=u-1>=0, the cone is EXACTLY {R : L5,L4,L3,R2,R1,R0 >=0}, where L5=R5, L4=R4-2delta R5, L3=R3-delta R4+delta^2 R5. Proof: these functionals are >=0 on all 15 generators (checked term by term), and the minimal-spillover representation c23=R5, c13=L4, c03=L3, c02=R2, c01=R1, c00=R0 reconstructs R. The coefficients R5..R0 are explicit in (delta, P2=p-2, Q0=1-p+q, z), with w=P2-3delta>0 and Q(-u)>=0 iff Q0>=delta(P2-delta).
EXACT mini-result: at delta=0 (holdings (1,1,1,w,1,1,1)), L5 and L4 force P2(1-2z)>=0, then R0 fails. So this sub-family realizes the spectrum IFF z<=1/2. Heterogeneity u!=1 is necessary above 1/2.

For delta>0, L5 vs L4 is EXACTLY equivalent to P2(1+3delta+3delta^2-2z) >= delta(3+9delta+8delta^2). L4 vs L3 gives P2(A_L D3 - A_U D4) <= B_L D3 - B_U D4, with explicit A_L,B_L,A_U,B_U,D3=2z+delta+delta^2,D4=1+2delta.
